cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned my cup upside down like yours. Ready for tea, love. I remembered your favourite without a birthday reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's drying. I've brought cake, a month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, let it dry. I'll warm you a plate for the cake; your birthday candle's still ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's your birthday I missed. Put the candle in and I'll sing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come closer, love. I'll shield the flame so we get further than last year's birthday phone call.

reason: Build an actual mistaken imitation into the shared activity, preserving distinct competitive-care, hopeful-connection, warm-resentment, emotional-pricing, and self-serving-repair tactics.
